_comment: Item merge list (swap lists 'merges', SwapLists.java; feature_writeup/item_merges.md 6): both items stay registered; the old one is purged and the survivor takes over its recipes, loot and tags (CD startup script creativedelight/swap_merges.js) and every stack of it in the world (Common swap/ItemMerges). Applied only while every 'requires' mod is loaded. Never prune: an old world whose old item is later unregistered is remapped from this list. Cantaloupe: Fruits Delight's hamimelon slice, popsicle and the generated can go into Delightful's cantaloupe ones (item_merges.md 2.10); Fruits Delight's apple tree goes into Vinery's (2.11).
